description: This file contains helper functions for generating GN build configurations, including architecture name resolution and toolchain file creation.

methods.name: gn_host_arch_name
methods.description: Returns a GN architecture name based on the host's build architecture.

methods.name: gn_target_arch_name
methods.description: Returns a GN architecture name for the target architecture, based on overrides.

methods.name: write_toolchain_file
methods.description: Creates a GN toolchain configuration file at the specified path.
